# Salgsstart Valseverket

I hjertet av Nydalen kommer Valseverket – et nytt boligprosjekt med 152 leiligheter i varige
kvaliteter. Her legges det til rette for et levende bymiljø, med grønne takhager, gode uteområder og
aktive byrom på bakkeplan.

Du bor tett på byliv, kollektivtilbud, butikker og servering, med Akerselva i umiddelbar nærhet.
Leilighetene varierer i størrelse og er tilpasset ulike livsfaser, med fokus på gode planløsninger
og hverdagskvaliteter. Salget av leilighetene er nå i gang.

[Les mer om Valseverket her][18]

[][19]

## [Kystbyen Slemmestad][20]

I Kystbyen Slemmestad vokser det snart frem et levende nabolag og bysentrum. Her blir det 1300
boliger og et rikt kultur- og servicetilbud. Her vil du ha alt du trenger for å bo, leve, dele og
oppleve – med nærhet til sjø, natur, og alt som trengs for å leve et komfortabelt og aktivt liv!
[Les mer om Slemmestad her.][21]

 

## [«*Det beste for byen er også det beste for oss*»][22]

Hvorfor Elkjøp, ice og noen av de største selskapene i Norge er kunder hos Avantor? [Få svaret fra
noen av våre fornøyde kunder her][23].

## Miljøprosjektet Nydalen
## – fra nedlagt industri til yrende liv

Historien om Nydalen er like mangslungen som elven den ligger ved. Den forteller om et område preget
av skog, senere tungindustri, så tomme fabrikkhaller og som nå yrer av liv igjen.

Siden tidlig på 90-tallet har Avantor vært den største bydelsutvikleren i Nydalen. For å skape en
grønn og moderne bydel, satte vi miljøstrategi øverst på agendaen. [Les mer om det vi har gjort for
Nydalen her][24].

# [Vi gjør alt][25]
# [for byens beste][26]

Det betyr også å gjøre det beste for våre kunder og alle deres ansatte. Vi er en av landets mest
erfarne eiendomsforvaltere og håndterer i dag mer enn 330.000 kvadratmeter eiendom. [Les mer om
drift og forvaltning her][27].

hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.

* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## protecting people and the resources vital to life.

People Health

Helping people thrive by protecting their individual health, the food they eat and the spaces where
they live and work.

Planet Health

Business Health

efficiency and sustainable impact. By tracking Total Value Delivered of Ecolab solutions, our
customers see how they are achieving their sustainability and business goals together. Interact with
our eROI counter to see how much water, energy, waste and air is positively impacted by customers
using our technologies.

Aarti Drugs Ltd. was established in the year 1984 and forms part of $900 Million Aarti Group of
Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.
* The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharma
  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.

  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,
  Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride, Methyl Nicotinate etc.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

Welcome To Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.

We deliver affordable and quality medicines across the world, regardless of geographic and
socio-economic barriers. This aptitude of ours can be credited to our successful portfolio of
businesses.

Through our efficient manufacturing services backed with highly qualified technical team, we
endeavor to build blocks to produce an organization that manufactures therapeutics for a variety of
diseases.

[Click here to][22] Download Our Brochure!

### Our Mission

We strive for a happier, healthier tomorrow. We shall be working on total customer satisfaction and
achieve leadership in pharmaceutical marketplace, products and services across the globe, through
excellence in technology, based on research and development , compliance with regulatory
requirements and expectation in an effective and efficient manner. Our human resources will continue
to be the most valuable asset in this pursuit of leadership and the prime driving forces for our
growth. We are responsible to society. We shall be good corporate citizens and will be driven by
high ethical standardizing our practices.

### Our Vision

Our vision is to be leading pharmaceutical company in India and become a significant global player.
Our aim is to be a global player, will lead to the establishment of operation in the key markets of
the world including the developing countries. We apply to enrich our people – our driving force, to
become highly competent professional and technology based.

Event Participation
* **CPHI Worldwide**
* **Arab Health**
* **IPHEX**
* **CPHI India**
Why Choose Us

Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. is a young & emerging global pharmaceutical manufacturing &
marketing company. We manufacture & market a broad range of Pharmaceutical finished formulations.

In the year 2000, Mr. Jitendra Prasad, a young Engineering graduate having pharmaceutical project
background, had established Akriti Export Agencies. In very short span of time he had given a
profitable shape of business to Akriti Export Agencies because of his hard work and very positive
mental attitude. Our activities range from manufacturing & marketing of finished pharmaceutical
formulations of Niche therapeutic segments. Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. has its headquarter in
Thane suburb of Mumbai, the financial capital of India .

Akriti Pharmaceuticals has operation in ** CIS Countries** and now expanding its wings to
**European, South East Asian, Latin American, Middle East & African countries**.

Our manufacturing unit has been approved with various International certifications and follows the
laid down norms of FDA India, CGMP under Schedule 'M' as well as it is **WHO-GMP **certified.

Welcome To Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.

We deliver affordable and quality medicines across the world, regardless of geographic and
socio-economic barriers. This aptitude of ours can be credited to our successful portfolio of
businesses.

Through our efficient manufacturing services backed with highly qualified technical team, we
endeavor to build blocks to produce an organization that manufactures therapeutics for a variety of
diseases.

[Click here to][22] Download Our Brochure!

### Our Mission

We strive for a happier, healthier tomorrow. We shall be working on total customer satisfaction and
achieve leadership in pharmaceutical marketplace, products and services across the globe, through
excellence in technology, based on research and development , compliance with regulatory
requirements and expectation in an effective and efficient manner. Our human resources will continue
to be the most valuable asset in this pursuit of leadership and the prime driving forces for our
growth. We are responsible to society. We shall be good corporate citizens and will be driven by
high ethical standardizing our practices.

### Our Vision

Our vision is to be leading pharmaceutical company in India and become a significant global player.
Our aim is to be a global player, will lead to the establishment of operation in the key markets of
the world including the developing countries. We apply to enrich our people – our driving force, to
become highly competent professional and technology based.

Why Choose Us

Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. is a young & emerging global pharmaceutical manufacturing &
marketing company. We manufacture & market a broad range of Pharmaceutical finished formulations.

In the year 2000, Mr. Jitendra Prasad, a young Engineering graduate having pharmaceutical project
background, had established Akriti Export Agencies. In very short span of time he had given a
profitable shape of business to Akriti Export Agencies because of his hard work and very positive
mental attitude. Our activities range from manufacturing & marketing of finished pharmaceutical
formulations of Niche therapeutic segments. Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. has its headquarter in
Thane suburb of Mumbai, the financial capital of India .

Akriti Pharmaceuticals has operation in ** CIS Countries** and now expanding its wings to
**European, South East Asian, Latin American, Middle East & African countries**.

Our manufacturing unit has been approved with various International certifications and follows the
laid down norms of FDA India, CGMP under Schedule 'M' as well as it is **WHO-GMP **certified.

## Dialysis Water
## Systems

AmeriWater’s broad portfolio of products include complete water treatment systems for central
dialysis (standard and heat disinfect), portable RO systems (standard and heat disinfect), ozone
disinfection systems, reverse osmosis, deionizers, filters, softeners, and storage tanks. We also
provide DI exchange and water testing services.

[Find Out More][60]

## Industrial Water
## Systems

AmeriWater offers a complete line of commercial and industrial deionizers and reverse osmosis water
treatment systems ranging in size from 20 GPD up to 252,000 GPD. AmeriWater also provides high
efficiency sand filters for cooling towers, which effectively remove fine particles as low as 1/4
micron.

[Find Out More][61]

## Central Sterile Water
## Systems

AmeriWater’s complete water treatment systems for central sterile processing are designed to use
minimum floor space while providing high quality water for washing, rinsing and disinfecting. We
also provide a line of FDA cleared filters for sinks, showers and ice machines, which aid in
infection control.

[Find Out More][62]

## GSA Federal Multi-Award Schedule

AmeriWater is excited to announce that we have been awarded a Federal Government General Supply
Administration (GSA) Multi-Award Schedule. This is for our water purification solutions for dialysis
and sterile processing, which is our TIR34/ST108 portfolio for sterile processing departments, and
our high efficiency sand filters for cooling tower applications.

[Find Out More][63]


## About Us

AmeriWater is a long-established industry leader in the design, manufacture, installation and supply
of water purification systems and services for dialysis, industrial and healthcare applications. We
offer a broad portfolio of high quality, flexible and trusted water purification products, all of
which are designed with the end user in mind.

## Dialysis Water
## Systems

AmeriWater’s broad portfolio of products include complete water treatment systems for central
dialysis (standard and heat disinfect), portable RO systems (standard and heat disinfect), ozone
disinfection systems, reverse osmosis, deionizers, filters, softeners, and storage tanks. We also
provide DI exchange and water testing services.

[Find Out More][60]

## Industrial Water
## Systems

AmeriWater offers a complete line of commercial and industrial deionizers and reverse osmosis water
treatment systems ranging in size from 20 GPD up to 252,000 GPD. AmeriWater also provides high
efficiency sand filters for cooling towers, which effectively remove fine particles as low as 1/4
micron.

[Find Out More][61]

## Central Sterile Water
## Systems

AmeriWater’s complete water treatment systems for central sterile processing are designed to use
minimum floor space while providing high quality water for washing, rinsing and disinfecting. We
also provide a line of FDA cleared filters for sinks, showers and ice machines, which aid in
infection control.

[Find Out More][62]

## GSA Federal Multi-Award Schedule

AmeriWater is excited to announce that we have been awarded a Federal Government General Supply
Administration (GSA) Multi-Award Schedule. This is for our water purification solutions for dialysis
and sterile processing, which is our TIR34/ST108 portfolio for sterile processing departments, and
our high efficiency sand filters for cooling tower applications.

[Find Out More][63]

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

### A Trusted Pharmaceutical Company manufacturing Bulk Drug API

[about]

APMIDA Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. manufacturing Bulk Drug API derived from various chemicals which
have a growing demand globally. The company is linked with developed pieces of equipment of the
technology and machinery for the process of the manufacturing of the Medicine product. The state of
the art manufacturing is Drug licensed and GMP and ISO certifications. Along with this, our
production place has the following amenities:
* #### We have vast and spacious warehouse in excise free zones to do the other activities of the
  #### manufacturing of the drugs.
* #### Quality control Lab and Analytical Testing along with R&D Manufacturing facilities
* #### State Drug licenses
* #### FDA Registered

### We are Helping to Advance Health with Clinical Trials for Medicine.

APMIDA PHARMACEUTICALS Pvt. Ltd. is a vertically integrated company that develops, manufactures, and
sells Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), High Potency API, and API intermediates. Our unique
research and synthesis facility reflects our commitment to research and innovation. The world-class
manufacturing facilities at APMIDA PHARMACEUTICALS Pvt. Ltd. are located in Dist. Rampur (UP)India.
These facilities are benchmarked to international standards and set to meet the rigorous quality
guideline, which is critical in achieving our global growth aspirations.

As a leading API supplier, our regulatory-approved facilities enable us to supply our partners all
over countries with a broad portfolio of products. Our expertise spans a variety of chemical
processes, Heterocyclic chemistry, Carbohydrates chemistry. Additionally, we manage enzyme
conversions for some of our products. Our manufacturing capacity for various categories ranges from
500MT/year to 800MT/Year.

## **Trusted Water for Injection &
## Aqueous Solutions Manufacturer**

[AQUABILITI] is an FDA-registered Class II medical device manufacturer who transforms water into
sterile pharmaceutical and medical-grade solutions that promote the highest levels of safety and
purity.  Operating within ISO 13485 certified facilities, we maintain rigorous quality systems
across all aspects of production. As a leading provider of high purity compendial waters, we
specialize in large-scale USP/EP-grade bulk packaged water for injection (WFI) and saline. Our
manufacturing capabilities extend to custom cGMP process solutions produced to exact customer
specifications. 

### **Diverse Packaging Configurations**

We offer a diverse selection of standard [packaging][65] configurations in sizes ranging from 3mL to
1100L for a variety of applications in the pharmaceutical, medical device, and healthcare
industries. Our commercial-use products, including [ bulk packaged water for injection][66] and
[aqueous process solutions][67], are offered in customizable bulk bioprocess containers (BPCs) as
well as smaller format options such as bottles and pour bag cubitainers, while our medical products
are comprised of [pre-filled flush syringes][68] with additional offerings in the works.

### **In-House Manufacturing**

As a fully vertically integrated facility, we manufacture our own custom single-use systems (SUSs)
for the sterile transfer, delivery, and packaging of product, allowing full control of the product
life cycle. We also develop tailored SUS solutions for seamless integration into customer workflows.
In industries where lead times are critical, [AQUABILITI] ’s in-house SUS manufacturing makes the
difference.

# Deus Medical - Improve the quality of life.

Our mission is to improve healthcare and offer the best solutions for a lifestyle of excellence - to
achieve the peak of your wellbeing and become the best possible version of yourself.
[
CHECK OUR RESELLER LIST
][126]

###### EVERY GREAT COMPANY STARTS WITH A GREAT STORY

## The Challenges of Global Health

Deus Medical was founded by many talented individuals, with varied skills and experiences, coming
together with the vision to finally get the high standard solutions which other companies one way or
the other have failed to offer. Reviewing the latest global health trends, we have a deep commitment
to making our company one of the best pharmaceutical companies in the industry.

Today, the consumer is well-aware of market conditions and chooses his brands wisely. People take
their time before making an informed decision in terms of buying a product. It is likely that he
will place his trust in a company that is a well-known brand, adheres to industry-acclaimed quality
standards, and uses the latest manufacturing technology.
* [ Generic Drugs ][127]
* [ Cosmetics ][128]
* [ CBD products ][129]

Generic drugs save consumers an estimated $8 billion to $10 billion a year at retail pharmacies.
Besides, more billions are saved when hospitals use a generic equivalent for the brand-name drugs. 

DEUS MEDICAL is the company producing top-quality cosmetics at reasonable prices. Our company is
managed by a team of international experts with years of experience in the market. 

CBD (Cannabinoid) products might one day replace many medicines for many people. CBD naturally
regulates your body and provide calm and stability to support a healthy lifestyle. 

[Stethoscope around the globe]

### Our Vision

We strive to be a global pharmaceutical company with an increasing focus on innovative research and
developed markets. We tend to improve healthcare and build a better world. As a growth strategy, the
company aims to establish partnerships with trustworthy partners and build our presence across the
globe.

### Our Mission

We continually practice an innovative approach for consistent quality through appropriate
groundwork, distinctive strategy, and technology. We deliver high quality and affordable medicines
that are manufactured in full compliance with global quality standards.

### Our Values

The core values we always think about define who we are – we want to bring excellent health care
solutions to people all over the world. We strive to provide a culture that accepts new ideas,
embraces change and rejects bureaucracy and small-mindedness.

## Research & Development

At Deus Medical we are passionate about science. We strive to deliver innovative solutions to ensure
high-quality standards for our products. Our product development team consists of highly qualified
professionals and they constantly continue research at Dues Medical to ensure our continuing
contributions to world health. All our research and development activities are closely focused on
current market needs and driven by technological progress. We take great care in managing our
operations with high concern for safety and the environment. We are proud of our innovative
manufacturing plants – we are equipped with highly sophisticated and advanced facilities. Deus
Medical is among the leading pharmaceutical companies in India with a strong export base of clients
and authorized resellers.

[ About DeusMedical][130]

###### State of the art facility

## Striving to deliver the highest quality

DEUS MEDICAL is one of the leading Pharmaceutical manufacturing brands in India with
state-of-the-art manufacturing facility situated at Kolkata. The facility is planned and designed to
meet local and international quality demands. We adopt industry best practices in all our operations
to ensure the highest quality standards of our products.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."
The data analysts use
to make their calls?
*It's right here.*

DrugPatentWatch pulls directly from primary sources — the USPTO, FDA Orange Book, ANDA filings,
litigation records, patent registers across 134 countries. **Every source an analyst would use.
Updated daily. No middleman.**

You form your own view. You run your own queries. You export everything and it's yours —
permanently. When the contract ends, the data doesn't disappear.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are

* [icon]

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

### Paracetamol DC Granules – Directly Compressible for Tablet Production

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

### New APIs – Theophylline, Rivaroxaban, Folic Acid & More

Introducing Our Latest API Range from Units 4 & 5

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

# Equipment Calibration Services

Whether addressing emergency situations, performing routine maintenance, or installation of new
equipment , our customers rely on the expertise and diverse experience that GL Technologies LLC can
provide. Our experience performing cGMP compliant calibrations and maintenance has been relied upon
by industry leaders in the medical device, biopharmaceutical and life science industries as well as
local municipalities and military installations.

We specialize in calibration and troubleshooting of Clean Utilities, Automated Process Equipment,
Analytical Laboratory Equipment, HVAC controls, [SCADA][18] and [Building Management Systems][19]
and [Passivation][20].

## GL Technologies Calibration Services

[GL Technologies]

GL Technologies is a full service calibration provider specializing in the Biopharmaceutical and
Medical Device industries. Our management has worked in, managed, and developed FDA cGMP fully
compliant programs. Our services include roving crews for the Biopharmaceuticals for regular
scheduled calibrations or shutdown and new system situations. GL Technologies also places qualified
individuals on various large and small Biopharmaceutical and Medical Device companies. The services
we provide include general Calibration/ Metrology support, asset and CMMS management, compliant
program development, SOP development, and maintenance/ facilities support.

GL Technologies can fully setup a compliant program including method development, Identification of
items to calibrate in a facility or on a system, tolerance assignment, calibration cycle
determination, and SOP design. Our management has personally been audited by and developed programs

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

# Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad
range of pharmaceutical formulation to cope with the necessity of ailing humanity. With its
headquarter at Mumbai (India), Healthy Life Pharma holds expertise in offering different
formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,
ointments etc.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is the flagship company of Shah Group, founded by Mr. Shah in 1976.
An encouraging leader and inspiring personality, Mr. Shah has continuously looked forward to shape
the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

Having three decades of experience, Healthy Life Pharma is a WHO recognized organization, which has
certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

## Formulation & Bulk Drugs

Tablets

Available for variety of applications in different forms such as uncoated, sugar coated, film
coated, chewable and more.

Capsules

Wide range of capsules that are available as antibiotic capsules, pain killer capsules, vitamin
supplements & tonics.

Injectables

Safe and reliable injectables that are
available in both powder and liquid
form.

Dry Syrups & Suspensions

We bring to you highly reliable formulation in the form of dry syrup for effective treatment of
variety of ailments.

Eye Drops & Ear Drops

Highly effective eye and ear drops that provide quick relief. These products are available in
sterilized and safe vials.

External Preparation

Avail from us a variety of external application products including ointments, creams and
antiseptic/disinfectants.

# Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad
range of pharmaceutical formulation to cope with the necessity of ailing humanity. With its
headquarter at Mumbai (India), Healthy Life Pharma holds expertise in offering different
formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,
ointments etc.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is the flagship company of Shah Group, founded by Mr. Shah in 1976.
An encouraging leader and inspiring personality, Mr. Shah has continuously looked forward to shape
the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

Having three decades of experience, Healthy Life Pharma is a WHO recognized organization, which has
certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

## Formulation & Bulk Drugs

Tablets

Available for variety of applications in different forms such as uncoated, sugar coated, film
coated, chewable and more.

Capsules

Wide range of capsules that are available as antibiotic capsules, pain killer capsules, vitamin
supplements & tonics.

Injectables

Safe and reliable injectables that are
available in both powder and liquid
form.

Dry Syrups & Suspensions

We bring to you highly reliable formulation in the form of dry syrup for effective treatment of
variety of ailments.

Eye Drops & Ear Drops

Highly effective eye and ear drops that provide quick relief. These products are available in
sterilized and safe vials.

External Preparation

Avail from us a variety of external application products including ointments, creams and
antiseptic/disinfectants.

How it works

## Two sides publish. Hell of a Partner matches.

A brand posts the distribution it needs. A distributor posts the capability it offers. Hell of a
Partner scores the fit and brokers the introduction.

Manufacturer / Brand

Publishes a distribution offer
* Product lines to place
* Target markets to reach
* Sales channels to sell through
* Requirements for the right partner

### Hell of a Partner, the platform

It scores every distributor against each brand's offer on seven weighted criteria, then brokers the
introduction. Contact details stay private until the request is accepted.

Distributor / Importer / Agent

Publishes a capability profile
* Markets and territories covered
* Sales channels operated
* Customer base already served
* Product categories handled
* Certifications held

What makes it different

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

[Browse the catalog by category and country →][8]
* Verified at the source
  
  Matched to official business registries (SIREN, CVR, RCCM and dozens more) or protected origin
  marks like PDO, GI and Genuine Jersey, not a self-declared badge.
* Sorted by category and country
  
  Find a specific product in a specific market instead of scrolling an endless, unfiltered list.
* Reachable even without a website
  
  Small makers surfaced through public registries and social profiles, with the source of every
  listing shown so you can check it yourself.

Matching engine

## Matching that explains itself

Every distributor is scored 0 to 100 against a manufacturer's offer on seven weighted criteria, with
a plain-language rationale, not a black box.
* 22%
  
  Country coverage
  
  Share of the manufacturer's target markets the distributor actively covers.
* 20%
  
  Category match
  
  Whether the distributor specialises in the offer's product category.
* 16%
  
  Sales channels
  
  Overlap between the requested sales channels and the distributor's channels.
* 13%
  
  Minimum order fit
  
  How comfortably the distributor's order capacity meets the minimum.
* 12%
  
  Certification fit
  
  Required certifications the distributor already holds.
* 9%
  
  Existing network fit
  
  Customer types served, brand portfolio size, partner-type match, and years in distribution.
* 8%
  
  Trade-agreement fit
  
  Preferential trade arrangements between the offer's target markets and the distributor's coverage
  (EAEU, EU, ASEAN, USMCA, CPTPP, AfCFTA, bilateral FTAs).

The government's decision to reduce GST rates is a commendable step towards enhancing affordability
and supporting public welfare.

Starting 22nd September 2025, we’ve lowered the prices of our products to match the recent GST rate
cut. This change shows our commitment to making healthcare more affordable.

All partners must bill at the new prices and make sure customers get the full benefit of the GST
reduction.

medication safety through learning, sharing, and acting to improve health care.

### Launch of the SMART Medication Safety Agenda

The SMART Medication Safety Agenda turns learnings from incidents reported to the National Incident
Data Repository (NIDR) into practical, system-based guidance to support community pharmacy teams.
This new resource pairs real anonymized examples with recommendations and a ready-to-use action
plan.

[Learn more][34]

## Partner with ISMP Canada

Our team of experts analyze reports of medication errors from across the country and provide
resources, education, and consulting services to improve medication safety.

The Canadian Medication Safety Network provides a chance to hear from health care providers and
consumers about medication safety needs and opportunities from communities across the country.

[Register for the Network][35]

### Learn

We collect and analyze reports of medication errors and other issues so we can *learn* about the
risks related to medications and collaboratively develop strategies to address them.
* Practitioners, community pharmacies, consumers and caregivers can report your experiences with
  medication errors.

[Submit a report][36]

### Share

We *share* lessons learned, including compelling actionable, evidence-informed recommendations that
organizations, practitioners, consumers, and caregivers can use to reduce the risks related to
medications.

[See the latest bulletins for healthcare professionals ][37]
[See the latest consumer newsletters ][38]
[See Shared Learning from Community Pharmacy Reporting][39]

### Act

We partner to implement, sustain, and evaluate medication safety improvements in practice.

Want to *act* now?

Join the Canadian Medication Safety Network to be part of this medication safety community of
learning!

[Register for the Network ][40]

### 2026 - Volume 26

ISSUE 7

#### [Hospital Readmissions Associated with Medication Incidents during Transitions of Care][51]

Hospital readmissions cost the Canadian health care system an estimated $2.9 billion in 2023. In
addition to the financial cost, returning to hospital can affect the patient's overall health and
their trust in the health care system. This bulletin highlights the findings from an analysis of
medication incidents associated with an emergent need to return to hospital (including hospital
readmissions and emergency department visits). Recommendations to optimize safe transitions of care
are shared to help minimize return to hospital as a result of a medication incident.

[Bulletin PDF][52]
ISSUE 6

#### [Palliative Care at Home – PART 2: ANALYSIS OF A FATAL INCIDENT][53]

Palliative care provides symptom management and supportive care to patients living with serious or
life-limiting illness. Increasing numbers of patients choose to receive this form of care in the
home. This bulletin, the second of a 2-part series, describes the analysis of a fatal incident
involving HYDROmorphone used for pain management in a palliative home care setting and shares
recommendations for the safe procurement, prescription, administration, and monitoring of opioid
medications provided in palliative care kits.

[Bulletin PDF][54]

### [Community Pharmacy Reporting & Learning][57]

The Canadian Medication Incident Reporting and Prevention System (CMIRPS) is a collaborative
pan-Canadian program of Health Canada, ISMP Canada, Canadian Institute for Health Information,
Patients for Patient Safety Canada and Healthcare Excellence Canada. The goal of CMIRPS is to reduce
and prevent harmful medication incidents in Canada.

### 2026 - Volume 26

ISSUE 7

#### [Hospital Readmissions Associated with Medication Incidents during Transitions of Care][51]

Hospital readmissions cost the Canadian health care system an estimated $2.9 billion in 2023. In
addition to the financial cost, returning to hospital can affect the patient's overall health and
their trust in the health care system. This bulletin highlights the findings from an analysis of
medication incidents associated with an emergent need to return to hospital (including hospital
readmissions and emergency department visits). Recommendations to optimize safe transitions of care
are shared to help minimize return to hospital as a result of a medication incident.

[Bulletin PDF][52]
ISSUE 6

#### [Palliative Care at Home – PART 2: ANALYSIS OF A FATAL INCIDENT][53]

Palliative care provides symptom management and supportive care to patients living with serious or
life-limiting illness. Increasing numbers of patients choose to receive this form of care in the
home. This bulletin, the second of a 2-part series, describes the analysis of a fatal incident
involving HYDROmorphone used for pain management in a palliative home care setting and shares
recommendations for the safe procurement, prescription, administration, and monitoring of opioid
medications provided in palliative care kits.

[Bulletin PDF][54]

anonymously submit reports of incidents to the National Incident Data Repository for Community

The Canadian Medication Incident Reporting and Prevention System (CMIRPS) is a collaborative
pan-Canadian program of Health Canada, ISMP Canada, Canadian Institute for Health Information,
Patients for Patient Safety Canada and Healthcare Excellence Canada. The goal of CMIRPS is to reduce
and prevent harmful medication incidents in Canada.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]

## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM

cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which

# Introduction to Pharmaceutical SOPs

Standard Operating Procedures (*SOPs*) are the cornerstone of operational consistency and regulatory
compliance in the pharmaceutical industry. SOPs provide standardized instructions for performing
various tasks, processes, or operations, ensuring that these activities are carried out in a
consistent and controlled manner. In the highly regulated pharmaceutical industry, where safety,
quality, and compliance are paramount, SOPs play an essential role in maintaining high operational
standards and minimizing the risk of errors.

In this guide, we will explore the *definition* of SOPs, highlight their *importance* in the
pharmaceutical industry, and provide an overview of the compliance requirements necessary for
ensuring product safety and regulatory adherence. We will also touch upon best practices for
creating, maintaining, and implementing SOPs that align with both local and international standards.

## What Are Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)?

*Standard Operating Procedures* (SOPs) are detailed, written instructions that describe the specific
steps necessary to perform routine or repetitive tasks consistently. These instructions help
standardize operations, ensuring that processes are conducted in a uniform manner every time. SOPs
are widely used across various industries, but they are particularly critical in highly regulated
sectors like pharmaceuticals, where product quality, safety, and efficacy are directly tied to
regulatory compliance.

At their core, SOPs serve to:
* **Ensure Consistency:** By clearly defining each step in a process, SOPs guarantee that every task
  is completed in the same way, reducing the chance for errors and deviations.
* **Maintain Quality Standards:** SOPs provide a reliable way to ensure that the production of
  pharmaceutical products meets the required quality standards every time.
* **Facilitate Training:** SOPs are key training tools for employees, particularly new staff. They
  serve as references for performing tasks correctly and efficiently.
* **Ensure Compliance:** By following prescribed procedures, companies ensure that they comply with
  industry regulations, including Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), ISO standards, and FDA
  requirements.

Pharmaceutical SOPs generally outline detailed procedures, responsibilities, safety considerations,
and documentation requirements. For instance, an SOP for manufacturing might outline the specific
materials, equipment, and processes needed to produce a drug product in compliance with GMP
standards.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

## Universal Plastic Mold (UPM) is Your Injection Molding Partner

For more than 60 years, Universal Plastic Mold has been a leading manufacturer of high tonnage
custom and large part injection molding thanks to our one-stop facility. We want to provide a
single, convenient source for your injection molding needs. Thanks to our diverse array of plastic
injection molding equipment, our company can handle all of your plastic injection molding needs.
We’ve mastered putting together a complete plastics manufacturing strategy, and our goal is to go
far beyond making plastics.

Universal Plastic Mold is proud to offer premier, full-service program management, convenient
assembly, product distribution, and logistics services to streamline your manufacturing process and
help you keep your company on track. Our comprehensive plastic injection molding services help our
clients save money, reduce overhead, cut down on time to market, and increase their overall product
quality. This is why we’re the injection mold manufacturer of choice for businesses across the
United States.

We are pleased to have the tools necessary to serve the needs of businesses of all sizes across a
wide range of industries. Our mission has always been to help our customers produce as many quality
products as possible for their needs in any shape or size. Learn more about what makes UPM a leader
in plastic mold manufacturing and how you and your business can take advantage of our services
today.

[ About Us ][74]

## Plastic Injection Molding

When you choose UPM, your satisfaction is our top priority. We work around the clock to meet your
needs. With over 300 employees and a full 24/7/365 operation, we have both the plastic injection
molding capabilities and management experience to ensure your project is executed properly. We are
an all-in-one facility that can handle production, assembly, packaging, warehousing, direct
shipping, and more. UPM is proud to deliver turnkey, worry-free results to customers nationwide.

Plastic injection molding is a complex process that touches every facet of your life practically
every day. Every time you drink from a water bottle, play with a toy or get in your car, you’re
using something that was made through the process of plastic injection molding. Universal Plastic
Mold houses all kinds of machines ranging from 175 tons to 2,000 tons so that you can be confident
we have the equipment you need for your plastic manufacturing requirements. Whether you need to
manufacture plastic parts for your business or are looking to a create a prototype for an entirely
new product, UPM is here to help you every step of the way. That’s why we’re a considered a leader
among custom plastic molding companies across the nation.

# Fix My Speakers 🔊

Eject 💦 water from your phone’s speakers after getting it wet.

Fix My Speakers – Water Eject 💦 from your phone’s speakers effortlessly💦

[💨 Let’s Start 💦][11]

Are you frustrated by your muffled speaker due to water or dust? Don’t worry Fix My Speaker easily
ejects the water and dust from the speaker. With just a few taps, you can restore your audio to its
former glory and enjoy the crystal-clear sound once again. So, what are you waiting for? Dive in,
play the speaker cleaner sounds, and get your speaker back in action.

[Fix My Speakers – Water Eject From Your Phone’s Speakers Effortlessly]

## Speaker Cleaner **Steps**
* Disconnect your mobile from a Bluetooth device or earbuds if you are using it.
* Turn up the volume to the maximum level.
* Hold your device tilted so the phone’s speaker is downwards.
* Select the sound, click play button and play the sound until the end.
* Play every sound three times until the end and then move to the next sound.

[💨 Let’s Start 💦][12]

Repeat this process if your speaker problem persists after playing every sound thrice.

### What is Fix My Speaker?

Fix My Speaker is an innovative web application that provides specialized cleaning sounds for mobile
speakers. By playing these sounds, you can efficiently expel water and clear away dust particles. It
offers a fast and effective solution to restore your speaker’s performance and sound clarity,
especially after water damage.

### How Does Fix My Speaker Work?

Fix My Speaker utilizes a variety of tones and sound waves, ranging from low to high frequencies, to
expel water and eliminate dust from your mobile speakers. It operates similarly to the water
ejection feature found in Apple Watches, providing an easy and effective way to restore your
speaker’s functionality.

### How does the Fix My Speakers process begin?

The process starts with a powerful sound burst at a high decibel level. This burst generates strong
vibrations that shake the speaker’s diaphragm, dislodging trapped water and initiating the cleaning
process.

### What ensures comprehensive cleaning?

After the initial burst, the system uses continuous frequency sweeps. These sweeps cycle through low
to high frequencies, effectively removing remaining water droplets and dust particles from the
speaker grill.

### How is residual moisture removed?

A high-pitched tone is used in the final step to eliminate any residual moisture. This tone reaches
deep into the speaker’s interior, drying out any remaining water for a completely clean and
moisture-free speaker.

[💨 Let’s Start 💦][13]


**Preventive Measures to Avoid Water Damage**
1. Avoid Water Exposure
   * Keep your phone away from liquids and steer clear of environments where it might come into
     contact with water, such as near pools, beaches, sinks, or during rain.
2. Use Protective Cases
   * Invest in a durable, water-resistant phone case. These cases provide an extra layer of
     protection against accidental spills, splashes, and humidity.
3. Be Cautious Outdoors
   * Environmental factors like rain, high humidity, and dust storms can damage electronic devices.
     When heading outdoors, especially during uncertain weather, protect your gadgets and
     accessories with waterproof covers.
4. Maintain Your Phone
   * Regular upkeep is crucial to prevent dust and moisture buildup. Clean your device regularly to
     ensure it remains dust-free and dry. [Learn more about keeping your phone clean here.]
5. Backup Your Data
   * Always save your important files on cloud services like Google Drive. This precaution ensures
     you don’t lose valuable data in case of severe damage or device failure.

### What is Fix My Speaker?

Fix My Speaker is an innovative web application that provides specialized cleaning sounds for mobile
speakers. By playing these sounds, you can efficiently expel water and clear away dust particles. It
offers a fast and effective solution to restore your speaker’s performance and sound clarity,
especially after water damage.

### How Does Fix My Speaker Work?

Fix My Speaker utilizes a variety of tones and sound waves, ranging from low to high frequencies, to
expel water and eliminate dust from your mobile speakers. It operates similarly to the water
ejection feature found in Apple Watches, providing an easy and effective way to restore your
speaker’s functionality.

### How does the Fix My Speakers process begin?

The process starts with a powerful sound burst at a high decibel level. This burst generates strong
vibrations that shake the speaker’s diaphragm, dislodging trapped water and initiating the cleaning
process.

### What ensures comprehensive cleaning?

After the initial burst, the system uses continuous frequency sweeps. These sweeps cycle through low
to high frequencies, effectively removing remaining water droplets and dust particles from the
speaker grill.

### How is residual moisture removed?

A high-pitched tone is used in the final step to eliminate any residual moisture. This tone reaches
deep into the speaker’s interior, drying out any remaining water for a completely clean and
moisture-free speaker.

## **Immediate Actions to Take if Your Phone Gets Wet**
1. **Turn Off the Phone:** Power off your device immediately to avoid short circuits and prevent
   damage to electronic components caused by water.
2. **Disconnect Accessories:** Remove any accessories, such as cases, chargers, or headphones, to
   reduce the risk of further damage to the device.
3. **Dry the Exterior:** Gently dab the phone with a soft, lint-free cloth to absorb visible
   moisture. Avoid using heat sources like hairdryers, as they can damage internal components and
   the screen.
4. **Remove Moisture:** Carefully clean the exterior, focusing on areas like speaker grilles, using
   a soft cloth to eliminate trapped dust and moisture.
5. **Let It Dry:** Place the device in a dry, well-ventilated area for 24 to 48 hours to ensure all
   moisture evaporates before attempting to power it on again.
6. **Avoid Heat Exposure:** Do not use heat guns or direct heat to dry the phone, as this can cause
   additional damage to internal parts.
7. **Seek Professional Assistance:** If the phone remains unresponsive or malfunctioning after
   drying, consult a professional repair service for proper evaluation and repair.

# WATER FOR INJECTION SYSTEMS

## proud to be AT the heart of the pharmaceutical manufacturing system

Water is an intrinsic component of all pharmaceutical formulations; without water there can be no
preparations to make vaccines, IV Fluids, parenteral solutions, ointments, eye drops, antibiotics,
creams and all drugs that require a solvent compatible with human nature. This BRAM-COR site
clarifies some aspects related to the use of Water for Injection and other pharmaceutical grade

[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[[Tablets]][21]

Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
